game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon, the beacon on the peak: the sherpa guide must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the radio mast.
theme: Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon: the beacon on the peak
core_gameplay_loop: In Peak Beacon, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the radio mast. Each round, ice hawks strike the radio mast, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the vault_keys value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the radio mast from ice hawks in Peak Beacon: keep the vault_keys meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: vault_keys drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Peak Beacon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault_keys changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Peak Beacon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while vault_keys > 0.
